# Nitt — Smart Persian News Aggregator

> Nitt is an intelligent Persian news aggregator platform featuring real-time credibility scoring and automated article clustering.

## Core Features
- [Home - Latest News](https://news-grid-pi.vercel.app/): Aggregated Persian news from trusted outlets.
- [Features](https://news-grid-pi.vercel.app/features): Live credibility scores and rumor alerts.
- [Credibility System](https://news-grid-pi.vercel.app/credibility): Transparent 3-step algorithm breakdown.
- [About Nitt](https://news-grid-pi.vercel.app/about): Mission and contact information.

## Primary Endpoints
- GET /api/articles: Latest aggregated news with pagination and cluster scores.
- GET /api/categories: News categories.
- GET /api/prices: Real-time USD currency and Gold prices.
